name: garden-structure-designer-marketplace
description: Plugin marketplace for the garden-structure-designer — a multi-agent pipeline that converts plain-English descriptions of garden structures (pergolas, gazebos, pavilions) into professional-grade, structurally validated PDF construction packages.

plugins.name: garden-structure-designer
plugins.description: Multi-agent design pipeline producing professional PDF construction packages for garden structures. v1.3 features deterministic CAD kernel math, structure.json single data bus, independent adversarial drawing red-team QA, and end-to-end PDF packet compilation.
